description: This is an Android Java source file defining an abstract class named ShortcutAdapter. The class manages a list of ShortcutInfo objects, provides methods for binding data to views in a list (likely a ListView or RecyclerView), and handles user interactions such as launching shortcuts and performing secondary actions. It includes abstract methods for subclasses to specify layout and view element IDs, and methods to control UI visibility and behavior.

classes.name: ShortcutAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class for displaying a list of ShortcutInfo items in an Android UI component, managing shortcut data, view binding, and user interactions such as launching shortcuts and performing additional actions.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Abstract method that subclasses should implement to specify the layout resource ID for each item.

methods.name: getText1Id
methods.description: Abstract method for the ID of the primary text view within the item layout.

methods.name: getText2Id
methods.description: Abstract method for the ID of the secondary text view within the item layout.

methods.name: getImageId
methods.description: Abstract method for the ID of the ImageView within the item layout.

methods.name: getLaunchId
methods.description: Abstract method for the ID of the launch button/view within the item layout.

methods.name: getAction2Id
methods.description: Abstract method for the ID of the secondary action button within the item layout.

methods.name: showLine2
methods.description: Returns whether to display detailed secondary information about shortcuts.

methods.name: showLaunch
methods.description: Determines whether a launch button should be shown for a given ShortcutInfo.

methods.name: showAction2
methods.description: Determines whether a secondary action button should be shown for a given ShortcutInfo.

methods.name: getAction2Text
methods.description: Returns the label text for the secondary action button.

methods.name: onLaunchClicked
methods.description: Callback invoked when the launch button is pressed for a shortcut.

methods.name: onAction2Clicked
methods.description: Callback invoked when the secondary action button is pressed.

methods.name: setShortcuts
methods.description: Sets the list of ShortcutInfo objects to display.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of ShortcutInfo objects.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of shortcut items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the ShortcutInfo object at a specified position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the item ID for a shortcut at a position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether all items are enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether a specific item is enabled.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles a view for a shortcut item and binds data.

methods.name: bindView
methods.description: Binds a ShortcutInfo's data to the provided view, setting text, icons, and click listeners.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for launch and secondary action buttons.
